name: Creamy Pasta Salad with Rotisserie Chicken, Mixed Veggies & Parmesan

ingredients.name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, green beans, peas)

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until starting to soften, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp salt
10 oz pasta shells, medium-size

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place mayo, dressing, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
¼ cup Italian salad dressing
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones; separate the meat into shred-like pieces. Roughly chop chicken, then add to the bowl with the dressing along with Parmesan. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (30 oz) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
1 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is almost done, add veggies to the pot, and stir for a few seconds. Continue to cook until pasta and veggies are tender, 2-3 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, green beans, peas)

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta and veggies are done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates and enjoy!
